senses.gloss: ch. (v. בעי) to ask entrance, knock at the door.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 21">Lev. R. s. 21</cite>; Pesik. Aḥare, p. 177ᵃ <he>הוה מבעבע</he> used to knock. [Ar. reads <cite ref="K00967"><he>כעכע</he></cite>, quoting Lev. R. l. c. also for a Hebrew verb <he>לכעכע</he>; Rashb. to <cite ref="Pesachim 112a">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> quotes <he>נענע</he>.]
